The agents that buy eSIMs here are autonomous spenders who already pay crypto - a feeless instant Nano rail is the natural second settlement option. PANDeveloper001 token cannot file the issue (fine-grained scope, verified); recording for a member with repo-scoped token or via the operator's GitHub contact.
